text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We stop off at a mall on our way home
after a
day out, where we find people
getting excited
about an event.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I need a volunteer. Just choose
whichever card
you'd like. How about
that darling pony over
there? Care to
lend a hand?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Who, me?! Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh, guess there's a magic show.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Not particularly. But...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A lot of card tricks like that rely on
mathematical
logic.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While she doesn't reply, she does stop
walking,
and we end up observing Fuji
Kiseki's magic show
from a distance.
choice_data_list: Since we're here, let's watch for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy you came to watch my little

performance! Did you enjoy yourselves?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to hear it! ♪ It was extra
exciting when I
saw familiar faces in the
audience!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And judging by the look on your face,
Shakur, it
looks like I did all right.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't bad. Your packet switches were
natural,
and you diverted the audience's
attention like a
pro.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nothing. I was just thinking that you
sound
pretty knowledgeable.
Say...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I don't suppose you'd want to put on a
show
together?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Why would I want to do that?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've been puzzling over ways to
spice up
my performance recently.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I think having an intelligent, logical
person beside
me would be just the
ticket!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No. There's nothing in that for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur considers anything besides
racing to
be nothing more than noise. I
start considering
who might be more
appropriate for the role,
when...
choice_data_list: Maybe you should invite someone else...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In that case, would you at least help me
think up
some fresh tricks?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Why? It's not like I know all that much
about
magic or anything.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just having a new perspective would be
helpful. It
could breathe some new life
into the show, you
know? What do you
say?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on. Don't just lower your
demands to
try and talk me into it. It's
sad.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But fine. If you're gonna beg, I'll help
you think of
something now.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Wait, now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As promised, Air Shakur comes up with
an
impromptu magic trick on the spot.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So if you do this, you can move the card
to any
position within the three rows of
cards.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Three rows means it's base 3, and four
rows
means it's base 4. You can just use
a simple
method to turn the positional
data into values.
...Well, there's no need
to understand the
mathematical
component.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
As long as you follow the steps, there's
no chance
it can fail. Math is like a
flawless magic—one that
doesn't rely on
any fancy sleights of hand.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The correct input will yield the desired
results. It's
the same as the code for any
well-written
program.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! Who would've thought such a
simple
process could produce such
spectacular results?
My heart is dancing
just thinking of ways I can put
this to use
in my performance!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Did you really just come up with this off
the top
of your head?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing special. Anyone who
understands the
logic behind it could do
the same.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing special. Anyone who
understands the
logic behind it could do
the same.
choice_data_list: You mean I can make it, too?
Does that mean I can make it too?
Still, being able to improvise that is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see! Indeed, if I were able to create
tricks like
this myself, I could take the
show in any direction
I like! ♪
choice_data_list: You mean I can make it, too?
Does that mean I can make it too?
Still, being able to improvise that is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Shakur, would you do us the honor of
becoming
our magic teacher?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Me, a teacher? You're kiddin', right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I agree. And even though the logic
behind it is so
complex, the trick itself is
simple and easy to
understand.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You've definitely got a flair for
showmanship. If
you ever feel like
joining the act, just speak up!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, like I'd be caught dead doing
that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm outta here. And just so we're clear,
that was
all the help I'm giving you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Just leave me alone, will ya?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur makes a rather cold
departure, leaving
me to consider what I
can do to assist this
complicated, yet
incredibly talented
Umamusume.
